rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 12 line 71/chunk 10 line 60: 'the diagnostic' / 'the journal' resolve to slide 2 line 12 'Decision Journal' and line 14 'weekly diagnostic agent' and header line 48; nearest miss is line 60 'the journal keeps it', antecedent named earlier in-file.
line 38-50 include links are structural; no 'the opening lecture' style positional callback. Closest: line 75 'Next you ask them' points forward to the next module by reading order only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 71 'what the diagnostic told you' resolves to the diagnostic scheduled in-module (line 48-50 Keep it learning); line 56 'what this session produced' is a session artifact. Closest: line 71.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal demo beat in the file

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 'Keep it learning' lines 48-50 is the thinnest, one include link, but structural include of an exercise that carries the slide content; every other chunk holds 2+ claims (nearest: line 34 open question after line 32 folder step).
line 54-60 header 'Did you make progress?' matches content that asks exactly the two questions; closest: line 23 'Freedom to choose' over bullets that grant choices (25-28).

grep -nE '(^|[.] )Not [a-z]' body → 0 hits; no anaphora triples (lines 25-28 open with different verbs); no superlatives; nearest: line 18 'Every exercise runs on the people you lead, not on a case study.' single contrast, not Not X Not Y Z.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: view greps banned_words/session_biography CLEAN; 'Team Knowledge', 'Decision Journal', 'Quality Gate' (line 12) are the module's own artefact names an engineer reads; nearest: line 71 'diagnostic' is ordinary ops vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 71 bolds a whole lead sentence (~20 words) on Bring to Module 2, over the handle cap; one bold on the slide, logistics slide, and sibling Bring-to slides in ask-before-you-move.md:52 and find-the-two-crux.md:62 share the shape, so the sibling is the answer per the rule's own test. Lines 11-14 What You'll Learn verb bolds are template-mandated (N/A part). Filed as suggestion, not REVISE.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: all 12 measured slides are top-level ## sections of the module file; node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file → slides: 12, oversized: 0, so every ## chunk reaches the deck model. Only long-read/deck structural check possible here; renders not run.

rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js → 'OK — 59 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.'; no numbered headers in body.

rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js → 'OK — 59 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.'; grep -nEi 'above|below|further down|see below|at the top' body → 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '](' → 5, all standalone include links (lines 38,40,44,46,50); no in-body links to judge; rule sets no gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file → 'slides: 12 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets oversized: 0'; largest bullet count is What You'll Learn at 4.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: module file: headings are canonical section names or imperative labels; rule binds exercise/lecture headings and law slides

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 67 'A memory an agent re-reads each week learns; a memory nobody opens goes stale.' is the nearest aphorism but is a Key Concepts item stating a concept, not a kicker restating a header; line 60 'that is an answer, and the journal keeps it' is a rescue the student needs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git log for the file shows a single commit d0d97b04 (initial generation); no header-only rename, so no inherited bullets. Nearest: line 54-56 body answers its header 'Did you make progress?'.

suggestions.now: **One observation per person you talked to, in `observations/`, and a diagnostic that has run at least once more.** Module 2 opens by asking what the diagnostic told you that you did not already know.
suggestions.proposed: **Observations** per person you talked to, in `observations/`, and **one more diagnostic run**. Module 2 opens by asking what the diagnostic told you that you did not already know.
